name: Adobe Illustrator CC 2021 (v25)
summary: Vector editing works through Wine with GPU preview off; sign-in, cloud documents and some panels do not.
notes:
Illustrator 2021 (25.x) installs and runs through Wine for drawing, pen/shape tools, type, pathfinder, layers, artboards, export (AI/PDF/SVG/PNG). Newer releases (2022+) fail to install or crash - use the 2021 standalone (offline) installer with a licence you already own; the Creative Cloud desktop app does NOT run, so Sign in, Libraries, Cloud documents, Adobe Fonts and Stock are unavailable and some panels that embed a web view stay blank.
After installing: Edit > Preferences > Performance > untick 'GPU Performance' (GPU preview needs DirectX features Wine cannot provide; the CPU preview is fine). Very large documents and 'Recolor Artwork' are slower than on Windows. If text renders as boxes, run 'winetricks corefonts' again inside this C:\ drive.
This recipe creates a 64-bit C:\ drive with Visual C++ 2019, GDI+, ATM, MSXML, core fonts, RGB font smoothing and reports Windows 10.
Native alternatives on Lindos: Inkscape (SVG/PDF, opens .ai files exported as PDF-compatible), Krita for illustration.
installer_hint: Set-up.exe from the standalone Illustrator 2021 package: lindos-run --prefix illustrator-cc-2021 ~/Downloads/Set-up.exe
